caption:
CHICKEN SALAD SANDOS!!

Make this super easy lunch option in a few minutes with any leftover chicken. 
Even a charred chicken tikka works well here. 

Ingredients:
1 Chicken Breast, pan fried with Salt and Pepper
1 Onion, finely chopped
2 Tbsp Mayo
2 Tsp Mustard 
1 Green Chilli OR 5 drops of tobasco
A handful of shredded lettuce
4 - 6 slices of Bread
